blind.B1: The superseries combining the 12 human EV miRNA samples (GSE218103) and the 6 C2C12 samples (GSE219099). The paper names GSE219100 as data for both the EV miRNA-seq and C2C12 RNA-seq (S2.6.p1, S2.8.p1). Exercise carriers: TD EX, CP EX (6 samples). The C2C12 part is not an exercise series, and the two parts differ in organism, platform and assay, so must not be analyzed together.
blind.B2: Human: CP vs TD at baseline and post exercise, n=3 pools each; pre vs post within groups. C2C12: miR-486 vs scramble, n=3 each.
blind.B3: Human part: pre/post pools of the same participants (S2.6.p1); title suffix within group would pair them (weak expression support). C2C12: none.
blind.B4: Human: joint genotype+activity DESeq2 model (S2.9.p2). C2C12: not stated.
blind.B5: S2.9.p2: DESeq2, miRNAs with <10 counts removed, model with genotype (TD/CP) and activity (EX/CON), significant at adjusted p<0.05 (FDR Benjamini-Hochberg). No fold-change cutoff stated. Counts: reports no DEG total; S3.3.p1 gives miR-486, let-7a/b/e (baseline CP vs TD), miR-100, miR-877, miR-4433 (post-exercise CP vs TD); exercise did not affect EV cargo in any group. C2C12 rule not stated.
